name: target_project
description:
Bind this external MCP session to an existing ChatCut project.

Use this after list_projects when the user wants to continue work on an existing project, or when the connector starts without an active project. Subsequent project-scoped tools such as read_project, edit_item, read_script, and submit_export will target this project through the same external MCP session.

Use the returned timelineId/trackId as orientation for the currently active timeline and default video track. Call read_project for the project map, then use preview_timeline or inspect_item for the timeline scope you intend to edit.

editorBaseUrl.description: Editor origin/base URL. Defaults to CHATCUT_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5173.

projectId.description: Project ID or unique prefix from list_projects for the project to target.
